name: Transmogrification
desc: Transforms health potions on the ground in a radius around the caster into mana potions, and mana potions into health potions.

name: Transmute
desc: Transforms objects on the ground into gold with some loss in value. Move the pointer over an item and press the cast button ('c' by default). Potions and Spells cannot be transmuted.

name: Transmute All
desc: Transforms all items on the ground near the caster into gold.

name: Transmute Scroll
desc: Transforms objects on the ground into gold with some loss in value. Move the pointer over an item and press the cast button ('c' by default). Potions and Spells cannot be transmuted.

name: Transmute to Health Potion
desc: Transforms objects on the ground into health potions. Move the pointer over an item and press the Cast button ('c' by default). Only weapons and armor can be transmuted.

name: Transmute to Mana Potion
desc: Transforms objects on the ground into mana potions. Move the pointer over an item and press the Cast button ('c' by default). Only weapons and armor can be transmuted.

name: Zap
desc: Releases a small bolt of electricity at the Target.

name: Zapper Glyph
desc: Creates a rune that will create a lightning explosion and damage enemies when they get too close.

name: Crystwind Stone
desc: The ancient Town Stone of Crystwind. One of eight regional keystones required to complete the Trial of the Utraeans.

name: Elddim Stone
desc: The sacred Town Stone of Elddim. Used to activate the Great Northern and Southern Gates and summon the Maljin at the Circle of Ten.

name: Fallraen Stone
desc: The frozen Town Stone of Fallraen. Bestowed upon champions to awaken the slumbering sanctums across the frozen northern wastes.

name: Fury's Eye
desc: The fiery, watchful orb torn from the terrifying Fury. Dropped by a certain ambitious outlaw who clearly stole something way out of his league, coveted for its dark eldritch power.

name: Gavel of Convening
desc: The ceremonial Gavel of Convening. Struck at the Circle of Ten to initiate the ancient Utraean gathering and awaken the slumbering sentinels.

name: Grescal Stone
desc: The desert Town Stone of Grescal. Forged under scorching suns, critical to breaching the Great Southern Gate.

name: Hiroth Stone
desc: The imperial Town Stone of Hiroth. The eighth and final town stone, held in the sovereign stronghold of the peninsula.

name: Lang Stone
desc: The marshland Town Stone of Lang. Ancient key recovered from the treacherous swamps and goblin ruins.

name: Meren Stone
desc: The maritime Town Stone of Meren. Sacred talisman from the coastal haven, unlocking ancient pathways across the peninsula.

name: Quillrabe Stone
desc: The canyon Town Stone of Quillrabe. Etched with forgotten runes from the high mesas and desert passages.

name: Rune of Diamonds
desc: An intricate diamond-cut stone talisman bearing glowing Utraean glyphs, unlocking forgotten crypt doors and treasure vaults.

name: Tenstone
desc: The legendary Tenstone, synthesized from the harmony of all eight town stones and the Gavel. Placed upon the ancient dais to awaken the gargantuan Ancient Dragon.

name: Ancient Hassat Bow
desc: Adds 1 to Ranged Skill and inflicts +10 Acid Damage. Set Synergy: Ranged Skill bonus increases by +1 per piece equipped (up to +4 with full set).

name: Clockwork Crossbow
desc: Adds +5 to Ranged Damage (up to +20 with full set). Set Synergy: Grants 2 Health Stolen Per Hit at 2 pieces (up to 6 Health Stolen with full 4-piece set).

name: Crossbow of the Zaurask Champion
desc: Adds 10 to Health. Set Synergy: Health bonus doubles exponentially with each piece equipped (+20 at 2 pcs, +40 with full 3-piece set).

name: Guiseppi's Bow
desc: 10% Chance to Inflict a Piercing Hit and deals +10 Poison Damage. Set Synergy: Piercing chance increases exponentially (up to 40% with full set).

name: Solov's Bow
desc: Adds 4 to Maximum Combat Magic Damage. Set Synergy: Increases up to +8 Max Combat Magic Damage with the full Patents of the Inventor set.

name: Utraean Archer's Bow
desc: Increases weapon range by 5%. Set Synergy: Weapon range increases by +5% per piece equipped (up to +25% range with full 5-piece set).

name: Utraean Guard's Bow
desc: Adds 1 to Melee Skill. Set Synergy: Melee Skill increases by +1 per piece equipped (up to +5 Melee with full 5-piece set).

name: Adela's Spellbook
desc: Reduces the mana cost of Area Effect spells placed in this book by 10% (up to 30% with 5 set pieces). Increases Combat Magic spell damage by 11% (up to 15% with full set).
stat_bonus: -10% Area Spell Cost, +11% Combat Spell Damage

name: Ankh
desc: Sacred symbol of endurance and eternal spirit, sanctified in the ancient temples of Ehb.

name: Ankh
desc: Gleaming gilded ankh consecrated by high priests, radiating an aura of warding and grace.

name: Artifact
desc: An enigmatic relic from the golden age of Utraean civilization, humming with faint primordial energy.

name: Artifact
desc: An ornate ancient mechanism crafted from forgotten metallurgy, preserved through the ages.

name: Backpack
desc: Equippable portable container that expands inventory capacity with an additional 4x8 storage grid (32 item slots). Essential for carrying extra loot, potions, and equipment across the realm.

name: Chadek's Spellbook
desc: Reduces the mana cost of Healing spells placed in this book by 10% per set piece equipped (up to 50% mana reduction with the full 5-piece Chadekian set).

name: Charm
desc: A small enchanted talisman engraved with protective wards, warding off malevolent wilderness spirits.

name: Demlock's Spellbook
desc: Increases Combat Magic spell damage by 1% per set piece equipped (up to +3% with the full Demlock's Compendium set).

name: Gem
desc: An exquisite brilliant-cut sapphire gem favored by nobility and collectors of exotic wealth.

name: Gold
desc: Standard minted gold coins of the realm. Used for commerce, merchant trade, and purchasing elite equipment in regional towns.

name: Health Potion
desc: Restores up to 400 Health to the imbiber. Standard restorative draught for adventurers and warriors in combat.

name: Jewel
desc: A gleaming, flawlessly cut gemstone prized by merchants, enchanters, and royal treasuries across the realm.

name: Jewel
desc: A rare luminous jewel with intricate facets, commanding high value among master jewelers.

name: Jewel
desc: A deep-colored radiant gem mined from subterranean mountain depths, sparkling with latent crystal resonance.

name: Kmethekt's Spellbook
desc: Reduces the mana cost of Summoning spells placed in this book by 10% (up to 40% with the full 4-piece Kmethekt's Artifacts set).

name: Large Health Potion
desc: Restores up to 1,000 Health to the imbiber. Highly concentrated curative flask for surviving intense dungeon battles.

name: Large Mana Potion
desc: Restores up to 1,400 Mana to the caster. Essential for high-tier elemental channeling and extensive healing.

name: Large Rejuvenation Potion
desc: Simultaneously restores up to 1,800 Health and 1,800 Mana. Elite dual-recovery elixir favored by seasoned battlemages.

name: Mana Potion
desc: Restores up to 500 Mana to sustain magical offenses and maintain party defensive blessings.

name: Map
desc: Detailed cartographic parchment charting the towns, mountain passes, ruined keeps, and subterranean routes of the Utraean Peninsula.

name: Rejuvenation Potion
desc: Simultaneously restores up to 750 Health and 750 Mana, recharging both physical endurance and magical vigor.

name: Scroll
desc: A delicate parchment inscribed with arcane runes, ready to be channeled by an experienced mage or bound into a spellbook.

name: Skull
desc: The calcified skull of an ancient inhabitant of the peninsula, frequently utilized in dark necromantic rituals.

name: Skull
desc: A weathered bone relic marked by ages of entombment in forgotten crypts beneath the earth.

name: Small Health Potion
desc: Restores up to 200 Health to the imbiber. Can be consumed immediately or drank automatically as damage is received.

name: Small Mana Potion
desc: Restores up to 200 Mana to replenish mystical energy reserves during spellcasting.

name: Small Rejuvenation Potion
desc: Simultaneously restores up to 300 Health and 300 Mana to the imbiber.

name: Solov's Spellbook
desc: Reduces the mana cost of Fire spells placed in this book by 10% (up to 30% with the full 3-piece Patents of the Inventor set).

name: Spellbook of Cicatrix
desc: Reduces the mana cost of Curse spells placed in this book by 25% per set piece (up to 75% with 3 pieces). Grants +5% Nature Magic Spell Damage at 2 pieces (+10% with full set).

name: Super Health Potion
desc: Restores up to 2,000 Health to the imbiber. The pinnacle of restorative alchemy, instantly rejuvenating heavily wounded champions.

name: Super Mana Potion
desc: Restores up to 2,500 Mana. A potent surge of pure mana required to fuel catastrophic spells and elite summons.

name: Super Rejuvenation Potion
desc: Simultaneously restores up to 3,000 Health and 3,000 Mana. Supreme alchemical draught granting near-instantaneous complete recovery.

name: Xulphae's Spellbook
desc: Reduces the mana cost of Lightning/Electric spells placed in this book by 10% per set piece (up to 40% with 4 pieces). Increases Lightning spell damage by 11% (up to 14% with full set).
stat_bonus: -10% Electric Spell Cost, +11% Electric Spell Damage
